description: Todd Griffin's personal collection of Claude Code plugins and skills.

plugins.name: goddtriffin
plugins.description: Todd Griffin's own Claude Code skills. Includes audit-agent-docs: grade a repo's agent-facing documentation against a fixed standard; and mock-design: how a reusable mock implementation of an injectable interface seeds responses, records calls, and proves every seeded response was consumed; and upgrade-rust-repos: upgrade one Rust repo or a directory of them to the latest dependencies, edition, rust-version, and resolver, in dependency order, with zero regressions.

plugins.name: mattpocock
plugins.description: Skills from Matt Pocock. Includes grill-me: relentlessly interview the user about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree.
